purpose: Prepared source-review inputs, not new measurements or adopted-position findings.

cases.title: Ongoing saving work and its qualifications
cases.review_question: Does the passage state present acceptance or retention, or describe transformation without asserting either? Preserve the prayer frame and the scriptural quotation.
cases.caution: God’s continuing work must not become a claim of unconditional permanent security.

cases.title: Several voices within one passage
cases.review_question: Which statements belong to the preacher, Paul, Jesus and the reported middle-of-the-road Christians? Does any exact assertion express present acceptance, loss or retention?
cases.caution: An assurance finding does not make every quoted statement the preacher’s adopted position. Rejection must not manufacture an opposite doctrine.

cases.title: An invitation rather than a resolved position
cases.review_question: Do the questions invite a response, assert present acceptance, or leave the assurance relation unresolved? The current assurance value is below its frozen observation threshold.
cases.caution: Do not turn a rhetorical question into affirmation, or a below-threshold value into denial. This window is a review contrast, not an admitted assurance positive.
